summary: A 69-year-old man dislocated his shoulder and took a short fall off the Second Flatiron midday Monday; Boulder County Sheriff's Office received the call at 11:34 a.m. Crews responded and were working to get him down. He was not seriously hurt.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office | Rocky Mountain Rescue | Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks rangers
notes: Outcome not yet final at article time: crews still on scene as of about 2:40 p.m. and expected to be working to get him down for a while, per Boulder County Sheriff's Office spokesperson Vinnie Montez.
